name: History of Art
school: College of Literature, Science, and the Arts

requirements.label: 120 Total Credits
requirements.hint: All credits completed at U-M plus posted transfer credit.

requirements.label: 100 LSA Credits
requirements.hint: Credits from courses recognized by LSA (most U-M courses except some SI offerings and other school-specific courses).

requirements.label: 60 BS-Eligible Credits (for BS students only)
requirements.hint: Only counts for students pursuing a Bachelor of Science.

requirements.label: 90 Credits Excluding Experiential and Independent Study Courses
requirements.hint: At least 90 credits must come from standard coursework; internships and independent study don't count.

requirements.label: 60 Credits outside History of Art
requirements.hint: Credits earned in courses outside the History of Art department(s).

requirements.label: 90 Credits of Graded Course Work, Including Transfer and Test
requirements.hint: At least 90 credits must carry a letter grade (transfer and test credit included).

requirements.label: 60 Credits of In-Residence Course Work (AA Campus and U-M Study Abroad)
requirements.hint: Credits taken on the Ann Arbor campus or through an approved U-M study abroad program.

requirements.label: 30 Credits Taken While Enrolled in LSA
requirements.hint: Credits earned while officially enrolled in LSA (as opposed to another U-M college).

requirements.label: First Year Writing Requirement
requirements.hint: one course required

requirements.label: Upper Level Writing Requirement
requirements.hint: one course required

requirements.label: Race and Ethnicity Requirement
requirements.hint: one course required

requirements.label: Quantitative Reasoning Requirement
requirements.hint: 1 QR1 or 2 QR2 courses required

requirements.label: Language Requirement
requirements.hint: one 4th term course required, C- minimum, or one course where proficiency is presumed

requirements.label: Area Distribution: 7 Credits in Humanities
requirements.hint: From approved HU-designated courses.

requirements.label: Area Distribution: 7 Credits in Natural Sciences
requirements.hint: From approved NS-designated courses.

requirements.label: Area Distribution: 7 Credits in Social Sciences
requirements.hint: From approved SS-designated courses.

requirements.label: Additional Distribution: complete 3 areas
requirements.hint: Pick any 3 of the area buckets below and hit 3 cr in each. ID credit can count toward 1, 2, or all 3 areas, so the extra ID buckets can stand in for additional areas.

requirements.label: Additional 3 Credits in Humanities
requirements.hint: Beyond the initial 7 cr Humanities.

requirements.label: Additional 3 Credits in Natural Sciences
requirements.hint: Beyond the initial 7 cr Natural Sciences.

requirements.label: Additional 3 Credits in Social Sciences
requirements.hint: Beyond the initial 7 cr Social Sciences.

requirements.label: 3 Credits in Mathematical & Symbolic Analysis
requirements.hint: From approved MSA-designated courses.

requirements.label: 3 Credits in Creative Expression
requirements.hint: From approved CE-designated courses.

requirements.label: 3 Credits in Interdisciplinary
requirements.hint: From approved ID-designated courses.

requirements.label: 3 Additional Credits in Interdisciplinary (Second Area)
requirements.hint: A second 3 cr of ID credit may stand in for a second area.

requirements.label: 3 Additional Credits in Interdisciplinary (Third Area)
requirements.hint: A third 3 cr of ID credit may stand in for a third area.

requirements.label: Seminar: 1 Course, 300-Level or Higher
requirements.hint: One History of Art seminar at the 300 level or above. Current catalog seminars: HISTART 393, HISTART 395, HISTART 497, HISTART 498. Other HISTART seminars count as offered.

requirements.label: Chronological Distribution: 3 Time Periods
requirements.hint: 1 course in each of 3 time periods, chosen from Ancient, Medieval, Early Modern, Modern and Contemporary, and Transhistorical.

requirements.label: Time Period: Ancient
requirements.hint: 1 course covering the Ancient period. Current catalog matches by HISTART concentration distribution.

requirements.label: Time Period: Medieval
requirements.hint: 1 course covering the Medieval period. Current catalog matches by HISTART concentration distribution.

requirements.label: Time Period: Early Modern
requirements.hint: 1 course covering the Early Modern period. Current catalog matches by HISTART concentration distribution.

requirements.label: Time Period: Modern & Contemporary
requirements.hint: 1 course covering the Modern and Contemporary period. Current catalog matches by HISTART concentration distribution.

requirements.label: Time Period: Transhistorical
requirements.hint: 1 course designated Transhistorical. Current catalog matches by HISTART concentration distribution.

requirements.label: Geographical Distribution: 3 Regions
requirements.hint: 1 course in each of 3 regions, chosen from The Middle East, Sub-Saharan Africa, Asia, Europe & the U.S., Latin America & the Caribbean, and Transregional.

requirements.label: Region: The Middle East
requirements.hint: Includes Western and Central Asia and North Africa. Current catalog matches by HISTART concentration distribution.

requirements.label: Region: Sub-Saharan Africa
requirements.hint: Per the department's HISTART distribution designations printed in the LSA Course Guide, HISTART 208 / AAS 208 (Introduction to African Art) carries the Sub-Saharan Africa designation. Some HISTART 393, 394, and 395 seminar topics also carry it in certain terms; check the department's course listings (hartgalleries.lsa.umich.edu) for the term you plan.

requirements.label: Region: Asia
requirements.hint: Includes China, Japan, India, South and Southeast Asia, and the Pacific. Current catalog matches by HISTART concentration distribution.

requirements.label: Region: Europe & The U.S.
requirements.hint: Current catalog matches by HISTART concentration distribution.

requirements.label: Region: Latin America & The Caribbean
requirements.hint: Current catalog matches by HISTART concentration distribution.

requirements.label: Region: Transregional
requirements.hint: 1 course designated Transregional. Current catalog matches by HISTART concentration distribution.

requirements.label: Studio Course: 3 Credits
requirements.hint: One studio course of at least 3 credits at the 100 level or higher, taken at the School of Art & Design (Stamps), the Residential College, or the Taubman College of Architecture and Urban Planning, and approved by an advisor, per the LSA Bulletin History of Art major requirements (effective Fall 2023). The planner matches Stamps (ARTDES) and Residential College (RCARTS) studio courses in the catalog; Taubman studio courses and other advisor-approved studio work also count.

requirements.label: Cognate Courses: 3 Credits
requirements.hint: One additional advisor-approved course of at least 3 credits, selected from any discipline related to your particular interest in art history, per the LSA Bulletin History of Art major requirements (effective Fall 2023). The planner counts any 3 credits outside History of Art; confirm your choice with a History of Art advisor.

requirements.label: HISTART Credit Checks: Minimum 24 Credits
requirements.hint: Minimum 24 HISTART credits at the 200 level or above; at least 12 of these must be at the 300 level or higher, with additional 200-level HISTART credits as needed to reach 24.

requirements.label: HISTART Credits at the 300-Level or Higher: Minimum 12 Credits
requirements.hint: At least 12 of the 24 HISTART credits must be at the 300 level or higher.

requirements.label: Total Credits: Minimum 30 Credits
requirements.hint: Includes all courses used toward the major requirements, including those from other departments (e.g. cognates). Does not include any prerequisites. Planner counts HISTART credits; approved cognate and studio credits also count.

requirements.label: Residency Requirement: Minimum 15 Credits
requirements.hint: At least 15 major credits taken in residence at U-M. Planner counts HISTART credits.
